Operator decision (option 2): `test_durable_cwd_never_raises_when_the_callers_own_directory_is_gone` now runs on Windows. Merged as 8e1d15e664f (Gerrit 3481, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 on run 44800124584).

Change: the skipif is gone. The test chdirs to an empty tmp dir, then replaces `os.getcwd` with a stand-in that raises `FileNotFoundError`. On Windows it also replaces `ntpath._getfullpathname`, because CPython 3.13's `ntpath.realpath` resolves a relative path through `abspath` -> `nt._getfullpathname` and reaches `os.getcwd()` only when that raises. The test records the calls and asserts `os.getcwd` was reached, so it cannot pass without exercising the never-raise branch of `rebar._proc.detached_child_cwd`. The real rmtree-the-cwd variant stays as a separate POSIX-only test, `test_durable_cwd_never_raises_when_the_cwd_is_really_deleted`; it is not a `file-locks.args` line.

Windows evidence (throwaway probe on GitHub branch hydra-win-cwd, deleted afterwards): run 44661333542, job 136040016844, windows-latest, CPython 3.13.17, `os.path` is ntpath with `_getfullpathname` present. `pytest tests/unit/test_detached_child_cwd.py -rA -v`: 7 PASSED, including `test_durable_cwd_never_raises_when_the_callers_own_directory_is_gone PASSED`; the POSIX-only twin SKIPPED.
Proof that the test fails without the handling: in the same job, with the `try/except OSError` removed from `detached_child_cwd`, the test FAILED with `FileNotFoundError` raised from `store_repo_root`, pytest exit 1. The same break also failed it locally on macOS (Python 3.12).

This ticket stays open. Close requires 3 consecutive `sweep (windows)` runs on main that conclude `success`, counted from 8e1d15e664f onward. Earlier sweeps skipped this test, so they do not count toward it.
